newsitem.title: FRANCE: Havas nine month turnover rises.
newsitem.headline: Havas nine month turnover rises.

text.p: (All figures in millions of French francs)

NOTE - The company gave the results in a statement. It said sales in the nine month period rose nine percent compared to a year ago. It said turnover in France was up 9.5 percent and international turnover rose 8.0 percent. Restated for constant structure and exchange rates, the overall increase in turnover for the period was 5.1 percent, reflecting a 2.9 percent rise in France and a 10 percent increase in international business.
International business accounted for 33 percent of total consolidated revenues in the period. Turnover figures include only fully-consolidated companies, Havas said.
